title: The remote head was parsed from scrubbed output, so a short secret matching part of the ref or object name corrupted the result
resolution: GitRunner.runParsed parses the raw ls-remote output inside the runner and scrubs only failure messages; tests with a short secret matching the task branch ref and an object name.

title: A time limit above the setTimeout maximum passed validation and fired after 1 ms
resolution: Time limits above MAX_GIT_TIME_LIMIT_MS (2147483647 ms) are a RangeError; the boundary test accepts the maximum and refuses one more.

title: The time limit failure message was not scrubbed, so a credential form in the client path could leak
resolution: The runner scrubs each whole composed message, the time limit and the start failure, path included; tests with a secret inside the client path.

title: The runner time limit test raced a real timer against the shell recording its pids and had no upper bound
resolution: An injected ManualGitTimer fires after the client recorded its pids atomically; a watchdog bounds termination at 30 s and cleanup kills leftovers.

title: The stalled remote tests relied on the request reaching the server before a real 1500 ms timer
resolution: The server's beforeAnswer hook signals the received request, then the test fires the injected timer; a watchdog bounds completion and cleanup expires the timer.
